_comments.@duckdb/node-api: Pinned to 1.5.4-r.1 (DuckDB 1.5.4). History: originally pinned to 1.5.0 solely for DuckPGQ community-extension availability. DuckLake's compaction/CHECKPOINT crash ('DuckLakeCompaction - expected a single output file', duckdb/ducklake#525) was fixed by duckdb/ducklake#1095 (merged 2026-04-30 into branch v1.5-variegata) and confirmed working against DuckDB 1.5.4. DuckPGQ's community-extension build was separately bumped to target DuckDB 1.5.4 on 2026-06-30 (duckdb/community-extensions@f2476d8), so 1.5.4 is the lowest version satisfying both constraints. CAVEAT (open as of 2026-07-21): duckdb/ducklake#1108 is a related but distinct crash — a schema-cache key collision after DuckLake's automatic v0.3->v0.4 ducklake_schema_versions migration, triggered by per-table schema evolution (this codebase does ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN for blob metadata, see src/db.js). compactDuckLake() in src/db.js works around #1108 by running maintenance as six explicit calls with a fresh, unpooled connection per table for merge_adjacent_files/rewrite_data_files instead of a single CHECKPOINT. Before bumping past 1.5.4: re-check ducklake#1108 for a permanent fix, and confirm DuckPGQ has a matching build for the target DuckDB version.
